subject: Short testimonial + 60s video clip request — quick reward & scheduling
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@novusanalytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Short testimonial + 60s video clip request — quick reward & scheduling

Hi Carlos —

Hope you’re doing well. Quick ask: as part of Novus’s great rollout, we’d love a brief customer highlight you can share publicly — two parts: (1) a 2–3 sentence written testimonial we can post on TrustRadius and (2) an optional 60-second recorded clip (phone or webcam) that we can use in a short case highlight.

We’re offering a $100 Amazon e-gift card (or equivalent) per participant to thank you and any teammates who join. No heavy production — we can do a 10–15 minute sync to record if that’s easiest. I added a one-page talking-points doc to make it painless.

If you’re open, here’s a Calendly to pick a 15-minute slot: https://calendly.com/monica-patel/15m-advocacy. If you prefer, send a couple of time windows and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks again for the partnership — you’ve been invaluable getting the pipeline inference integration live.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Advocacy & Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-advocacy-talking-points-60s.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@novusanalytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novusanalytics.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short testimonial + 60s video clip request — quick reward & scheduling

Hi Monica —

Thanks — happy to help. I can put together the two-sentence blurb this week. For the clip, I can join a quick 15-minute call but I’ll need to loop in our legal team for a release (they usually sign off on recorded customer content). Procurement is CC’d so they have visibility on the incentive.

Two quick Qs: (1) Is the testimonial limited to TrustRadius or will Redwood also publish on other channels? (2) What’s the timeframe for publication?

—Carlos
VP Product, Novus Analytics
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ramirez <carlos@novusanalytics.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Short testimonial + 60s video clip request — quick reward & scheduling

Carlos —

Appreciate it and totally understand the legal loop. Short answers: we’d like the written quote posted to TrustRadius (link here: https://www.trustradius.com/products/redwood-inference/reviews) and we may also use the 60s clip on our website and in a short case-study microsite (we won’t syndicate to partners without explicit permission). Publication timeline: aiming to publish the written quote within 2–3 weeks and the clip within 3–4 weeks after sign-off.

I’ve attached a simple release template we use and a short talking-points doc to make the on-call recording quick. If procurement/legal want to review the release before scheduling, happy to take feedback.

Calendly again if helpful: https://calendly.com/monica-patel/15m-advocacy. If procurement prefers an invoice-based fulfillment for the incentive, our billing contact can provide the appropriate form — I attached instructions.

Thanks — will keep this lightweight.

Monica
Customer Advocacy & Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachment: giftcard-fulfillment-instructions.txt (TXT)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: sign-off and logistics for Novus incentive

Monica — quick internal note. I’m fine with the $100 e-gift card offer and the standard release, assuming procurement confirms the e-gift card is acceptable for their policies. Stephanie — can you confirm our fulfillment flow (email redemption vs. physical card) and whether we need a PO / SOW reference for DEAL-4892?

If procurement requires an invoice, please route to finance but try to keep the ask low-friction for Novus. Once you have calendar availability from Carlos, loop me and I’ll attend the call if helpful.

Thanks — Lauren

Redwood Inference
